6797.title: Realtime list refreshes bypass the existing throttle
6797.rootCauseOneLine: Structural and active-only thread-list handlers bypass the existing per-key refetch throttle.
6797.proposedFix: Share the existing one-second leading/trailing refetch scheduler across realtime list invalidation paths.
6797.caveats: Cache-level amplification reproduced twice; production rates, CPU share and timeline compression were not measured. Reproduction test is inline; raw logs remain local per the reports publication rules.
